preservation_rule: Failed tests, partial candidates, reports, scripts, manifest/proof files and research retain scientific/provenance value;do not delete whole experiments solely because timing failed. Await user clarification of what is dispensable.

protected.reason: 100MHz best adopted SATP009, WNS-0.553/TNS-322.607; preserve whole run and parent campaign metadata.
Historical gold WNS-0.553/TNS-434.730; preserve whole run.

Scripts/reports needed to reproduce closed package; baseline impl_1 itself remains negative.

Historical content-addressed evidence objects;same disk, preserve objects+manifest together.
Git history must be preserved;source tree and project are excluded from cleanup.

Old Vivado global scratch;all Vivado inactive now.
Downloaded compiler installation archive;extracted compiler exists but must verify executable+download provenance before deleting archive.

duplicate_caveats: Only files >=1MiB scanned for exact duplicates;Xilinx installation excluded.
Global duplicate estimate is upper bound;do not add it to cache or other option totals, they overlap.
Do NOT hardlink mutable source/project/build/netlist imports to immutable object archives;future Vivado/IP writes could corrupt all aliases.
Safe report groups exclude protected paths and all nlink>1 inodes;full alias inventory required before extending scope.
Do not remove path needed by an immutable campaign manifest;byte-identical hardlinking is path-preserving but gzip-in-place is not.
Before hardlinking, archive original path/stat/SHA mapping, recheck metadata and full hashes, confirm no open file descriptors, atomic replacement, after-hash validation.

compression_candidate.reason: Large failed-audit evidence;NOT trash. Compression/archive with hash roundtrip and reference review may save space without losing evidence.
compression_candidate.estimate_method: Full stream compressed in memory with zlib gzip framing level1;no compressed file written.
compression_candidate.precondition: Retain all content and old path references through explicit archival mapping;frozen manifests may require leaving original path uncompressed.

limitations: Inventory covers the listed work scopes, not the entire computer.
Large checkpoints, bitstreams, full endpoint censuses and existing content objects remain at original paths. Metadata without SHA does not verify their content.
Sources and generated builds in frozen copies are indexed only; immutable campaign manifests remain the source of RTL provenance.
This documentation archive is on the same disk and is not an external backup.

backup_review.finding: Archive and all backup folders inspected are on same filesystem. Scope manifest explicitly excludes full large DCP/bitstream/census content;not sufficient to delete source experiments. No personal-wide scan performed.

installation_excluded.reason: Active Vivado/Vitis dependency;uninstall or move requires separate dependency/installer review.

operational_readonly_check.note: Process snapshot found only audit shell/rg;no services stopped or signaled.

preservation_verifications.note: Only self-entry SHA256SUMS.txt mismatch;manifest includes a hash of its own prior bytes. Preserve as-is and document historical construction issue.
